milestones.outcome: An opt-in evaluation target measures sha1dc, HACL* SHA-2, CommonCrypto and QCryptographicHash against the core hashes on macOS arm64, and a committed report applies the decision rules per component.
exit_criteria: RFC AC01 for macOS: committed report with raw results, hardware, SHA-extension flags, builds and one adopt, reject or pending decision per component; Q1-Q3 recorded as unanswered.

RFC AC02 gate and AC03 detection evidence before adoption: CAVP vectors, chunking, seeded differential up to 256 MiB, git hash-object in both formats, trees and commits, the repository sweep and the collision inputs.
RFC AC04 for macOS: W1-W3 medians of 7 under the RFC conditions, and the window-thread baseline rows.
Candidates come only from pinned verified archives behind an evaluation-only option; dev, core-only, architecture and documentation checks pass.
milestones.boundary: Evaluation only: nothing enters core, third_party, dependencies.json or a package, and no candidate is added to the core link allow-list.

milestones.outcome: Feedback body digests come from platform crypto behind a host port, off the window thread, on macOS, if the per-site rule passes; otherwise the rejection is recorded.
exit_criteria: RFC AC02, AC05 and AC06 for the feedback-body site on macOS, with before-and-after window-thread rows and counters.
The report records the site's adopt or reject decision.
milestones.boundary: One site and one platform backend; other platforms keep the core digest until their station cards measure.

milestones.outcome: The evaluation runs on the Windows and Linux stations with their platform crypto arms, and the report gains their rows.
exit_criteria: RFC AC02-AC04 rows for each available station; a missing station is recorded, never inferred.
Q3 goes to the owner only if the Linux backend passes its rule.
milestones.boundary: Native station evidence only; no result is claimed for an unmeasured target.

milestones.outcome: The owner's Q1 answer is carried out: on Accept every SHA-1 Git identity and fetched-byte verification uses sha1dc and refuses collision inputs; on Reject core keeps first-party SHA-1, hashed block-wise, and the report states the remaining gap.
exit_criteria: Q1 Accept: RFC AC02, AC03, AC06 and AC07 for sha1dc (BPR-1450).
Q1 Reject: the RFC's fallback with the remaining gap stated, and the first-party control arm hashing block-wise (BPR-1452).
milestones.boundary: Starts only after the owner answers Q1; only the card matching the answer runs.

milestones.outcome: With Q2 accepted, the core SHA-256 is HACL* generated SHA-2 behind the unchanged stream contract.
exit_criteria: RFC AC02, AC06 and AC07 for HACL* SHA-2.
milestones.boundary: Starts only after the owner answers Q2 Accept.

milestones.outcome: Every RFC criterion is reconciled against the baseline with the owner's answers recorded verbatim.
exit_criteria: All seven RFC criteria have direct evidence against RFC_BASE_SHA or a recorded owner answer; tracker and architecture text agree.
milestones.boundary: Full RFC acceptance; no native, owner or package verdict is inferred.
